indices.name: S&P 500
indices.note: Lost about 265 points, a seventh straight drop, and is now in a correction.

indices.name: Nasdaq
indices.note: Fell about 1,261 points and is now down for 2026.

indices.name: Dow
indices.note: Dropped about 950 points, also closing in correction territory.

notes: The AI sell-off deepened: chipmakers led the slide, with Nvidia down about 14%, Micron and AMD about 13% and Broadcom about 12%; the Philadelphia chip index lost nearly 11%.
Worries about AI spending and valuations, a reported SEC look at Nvidia's accounting and hawkish Fed comments weighed on stocks; Treasuries rallied, pulling the 10-year yield to about 4.93%.
It was the S&P 500's worst week in over 18 months, down about 8.6%, while the Nasdaq fell about 10%; Anthropic slid 9% to $88.30, still above its $83 IPO price.
